symptom: `mxcli git merge <ref> --plan <file>` commits a valid two-parent merge that has silently lost one side's change to a unit the plan never names: ours adds `MyFirstModule.OursOnly`, theirs adds `MyFirstModule.TheirsOnly`, both edit `FeedbackModule.Feedback`'s documentation; the engine exits 2, the template lists only FeedbackModule's domain model, and after `--plan` with take theirs `TheirsOnly` is gone — the hash gate passes and nothing in the output mentions the unit
cause: applyPlan resolved from git's two sides — ours for every model file git conflicted, theirs for the planned units — and never ran the engine. Once the template listed only the engine's ManualResolutionRequired units, a unit the engine merges by itself (MergeContents/AutoResolved: an entity added on each side of one domain model) was taken from ours wholesale
file: `cmd/mxcli/cmd_git_merge.go` (`applyPlan` re-runs the engine over `checkoutRevisions` worktrees, checks the plan against `engineDecisions`, copies the result back with `copyEngineResult`, takes each planned unit with `git checkout <sha> -- <unit>`, `clearDecidedMarkers`, then refuses anything `conflictMarkers` still lists); `modelsdk/mpr/merge_conflicts.go` (`Reader.UnitConflicts`, `Writer.ClearContentsConflicts`); tests `TestGitMerge_PlanKeepsWhatTheEngineMerged`, `TestGitMerge_PlanMustMatchTheEnginesDecisions` in `cmd/mxcli/gitmerge_test.go`, `TestGitMergeIntegration_PlanKeepsWhatTheEngineMerged` (real mx) in `cmd/mxcli/gitmerge_integration_test.go`
insight: **"AutoResolved" means merged in the engine's result, not merged in yours**: a step that rebuilds from the sides instead of the result has to re-decide every unit, and listing fewer units to it hides the ones it gets wrong. Change the review list and the resolution source together. **The engine's exit-2 result is usable**: MINE holds every auto-resolved unit merged and marks only the undecided ones, in `Unit.ContentsConflicts` (a JSON list where every other row holds '' — not NULL); `mx check` reports CE0137 while a marker is left, which makes it the headless oracle for 'did the clear read as resolved'. Take a planned unit from its side's commit, not from MINE: MINE's copy of an undecided unit is not byte-identical to ours'. Measured with mx 11.13 on the PedApp fixture and an `mx create-project` scaffold. Pattern: docs-wiki/bug-patterns/rewrite-drops-unauthored-state.md
